name: rust
title: Rust
description: rustc, cargo, rustfmt and clippy with the standard library, from the standalone installer of static.rust-lang.org (no rustup). It links with the toolchain cc (zig cc), which is attached with it. Crates and build state go to ~/.cargo and ./target. rust-toolchain.toml files are not read (there is no rustup).

smoke.run: cargo new --quiet --vcs none hello && cd hello && cargo build --quiet --offline && ./target/debug/hello
cd hello && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --quiet --offline 2>&1 | tail -n 1; echo checked

notes: static.rust-lang.org was not reachable where these pins were made, so the archive is not pinned by a literal hash: it must carry a good signature of the Rust release key, which is pinned by its fingerprint (108F 6620 5EAE B0AA A8DD 5E1C 85AB 96E6 FA1B E5FE). The build writes the archive's SHA-256 into the entry's sources. Linking through zig cc is what the smoke test proves; cargo is pointed at libexec/rust-cc for it (a bare rustc call links with cc as it is).
